title: The Governance of Institutional Memory: Institutional Knowledge, Decision Continuity, and the Prevention of Governance Failure
summary: Proposes an integrated Institutional Memory Governance (IMG) framework addressing how institutions can preserve their capacity to learn, make informed decisions, maintain continuity and remain accountable when leadership and personnel change. The research goes beyond conventional records management to examine how institutions preserve not only documents, but also the knowledge, context, rationale, experience and lessons behind institutional decisions. It introduces seven interconnected governance dimensions and an initial assessment model, the Institutional Memory Maturity Index (IMMI), with particular relevance to public administration and state-building. Presented as a conceptual and applied governance framework; the proposed model and index require further expert review, empirical validation and field testing.
